description: Brazilian company record by CNPJ from the Federal Revenue (Receita Federal), with the special status when there is one (bankruptcy, judicial recovery, liquidation); its sanctions (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, leniency agreements, TCU and the CNJ's CNIA, checked live); partners on the politically exposed persons list (CGU); tax status (federal tax debt, installment agreements, tax incentives and construction works); the Federal Revenue chronic tax debtor list (`devedorContumaz.consta`: barred from public tenders); environmental and labor risk (forced-labor list, Ibama embargoes and fines); government contracts (PNCP, federal contracts since 2013 and sales to municipalities in the state of SP, from TCE-SP) and BNDES financing; registrations with regulators and official registries (CVM, Central Bank, ANS, ANTT, ANP, ANEEL, Anatel, Anvisa, CNES, Cadastur, Ibama, ANAC and SICAF); CVM investment funds; and the address on the map (CNEFE/IBGE). Accepts the numeric and the alphanumeric CNPJ. Personal data in the record comes masked. `sancoes` has what public registries record against the whole company (the CNPJ root), updated daily: useful to vet suppliers. The daily free allowance is 10 lookups per account, or per network without an account. After that, the operation uses the holder's lookup balance or returns 402 with the available payment options. Read pricing before spending.

temas.description: Comma-separated topics: dados, contagens, socios, sancoes, fiscal, divida, obras, trabalho, ibama, contratos, pep, vendas, campanhas, prefeituras, sicaf, aeronaves, fundos, rntrc, bndes, registros; todos. Omit for the full record. Basic company data always stays. contagens adds a contagens object with only the record counts (socios, pep, sancoes, fiscal, socioambiental, governo, registros). Unrequested blocks are omitted; null means unchecked. Personal data remains masked.
